name: @xbbg/xnews
description: Fetch, parse, and normalize market news, research papers, central-bank publications, and structured economic data from public feeds and APIs, with YouTube captions and transcription.
author: Alpha x1

scripts.build:core: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/catalog.ts ./src/parsers.ts ./src/asr.ts --outdir ./dist --target=node --format=esm --splitting --sourcemap=linked && bun run ./scripts/copy-sidecars.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph build
scripts.build:all: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:langgraph
scripts.typecheck:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:core && bun run lint:langgraph
scripts.lint:core: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.jsonc --tsconfig tsconfig.json src test scripts examples
scripts.lint:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:fix:core && bun run lint:fix:langgraph
scripts.lint:fix:core: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.jsonc --tsconfig tsconfig.json --fix src test scripts examples
scripts.lint:fix:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph lint -- --fix
scripts.check: bun run check:core && bun run check:langgraph
scripts.check:core: bun run typecheck:core && bun run lint:core && bun run format:check:core
scripts.check:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph check
scripts.test: bun run test:core && bun run test:langgraph
scripts.test:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run install:langgraph && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph test
scripts.pack:lint:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph pack:lint
scripts.types:attw:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph types:attw
scripts.quality: bun run quality:core && bun run quality:langgraph
scripts.quality:core: bun run check:core && bun run test:core && bun run build:core && bun run pack:lint:core && bun run types:attw:core
scripts.quality:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run install:langgraph && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph quality
scripts.smoke:packaged-install: bun run smoke:packaged-install:core && bun run smoke:packaged-install:langgraph
scripts.smoke:packaged-install:langgraph: bun run build:core && bun run install:langgraph && bun run --cwd packages/xnews-langgraph smoke:packaged-install
